units.source_text: 源氏内大臣回到二条院，休息片刻。

en.t: Genji, the Inner Minister, returned to Nijo-in and rested for a while.

units.source_text: 然后将嵯峨山中情状讲给紫姬听。

en.t: Then he told Lady Murasaki about what had happened in the mountains of Saga.

units.source_text: 他说：“我回家延迟了一天，心里很懊恼。

en.t: He said, "I was delayed by a day in coming home, and I felt very sorry about it.

units.source_text: 只因那些好事者来找我，硬把我留住了。

en.t: It was only because those curious busybodies came looking for me and insisted on keeping me there.
Then he went inside and went to sleep.
